## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Cyclicals (Industrials, Materials) are leading alongside Financials, and Growth (Technology) and Value (Financials/Industrials) are both showing positive 1W performance; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Top performers are Technology).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: MSFT (1W: +24.82% | 1M: +25.36%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +28.80% | 1M: +17.91%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: ETN (1W: +23.60% | 1M: +13.04%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND. Materials rising: FCX (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +17.24%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples lagging: KHC (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +1.70%) CORRECTION, MO (1W: -8.65% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND. Utilities/Real Estate weak with VTR (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -1.64%) BELOW TREND and AMT (1W: -6.24% | 1M: +1.71%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +28.80% | 1M: +17.91%) ABOVE TREND; MSFT (1W: +24.82% | 1M: +25.36%) ABOVE TREND; ETN (1W: +23.60% | 1M: +13.04%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +23.42% | 1M: -8.45%) RECOVERY; ORCL (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: VTR (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -1.64%) BELOW TREND; AMT (1W: -6.24% | 1M: +1.71%) CORRECTION; CVS (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND; ABBV (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND; CCI (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -4.38%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Real Estate and select Healthcare/Staples.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +28.80%), MSFT (1W: +24.82%), ETN (1W: +23.60%). Watch divergences: multiple large names show 1W vs 1M splits (INTC, AMAT, LRCX, GOOGL, META) — MAJOR divergence present, so watch for trend breaks and tactical opportunities rather than broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed but leading on headline moves; MSFT (1W: +24.82% | 1M: +25.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +15.37% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -8.04% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: +23.42% | 1M: -8.45%) RECOVERY. Sector strength is driving the RISK-ON call but leadership is concentrated; Technology is one of 5 positive sectors.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive and participating: JPM (1W: +4.22% | 1M: +5.90%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +7.49%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.64%) CORRECTION. Financials are a supportive pillar for the RISK-ON regime.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare soft overall: JNJ (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +9.10%) ABOVE TREND — mixed leadership inside a weak sector.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and Industrials exposure (JPM, ETN, CAT) given cyclicals participation; reduce exposure to concentrated Tech names that dominate the leaderboard and monitor AAPL in CORRECTION. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but narrow leadership warrants selectivity and risk management.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MSFT (1W: +24.82% | 1M: +25.36%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +20.30% | 1M: +10.84%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +17.24%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -8.04% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION; MO (1W: -8.65% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND; CVS (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology and Industrials (both showing strong 1W leadership). BEARISH: Consumer Staples, Utilities, Real Estate (these remain relative laggards).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
MSFT continue above 1W surge—watch for consolidation vs continuation near recent highs for ABOVE TREND confirmation. AAPL support zone to watch around recent pullback levels as CORRECTION stability would matter for tech breadth. JPM continuation above recent breakout region would confirm Financials strength; NVDA near recent swing highs will test momentum for broader Growth leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
AMGN (+80): analyst/earnings upgrade; price not in detailed excerpt for cross-ref, but sector Healthcare mixed — watch for confirmation in price action. EMR (+75): raised outlook; Industrials strength supports confirmation with ETN and BA strength. DD (+80): raised guidance and buybacks; Materials tailwind aligns with FCX ABOVE TREND.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
KHC (-75): charge reported; KHC (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +1.70%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirmed by price. JPM (-65): legal probe headlines; JPM (1W: +4.22% | 1M: +5.90%) ABOVE TREND — divergence between negative headlines and strong price action, watch for follow-through. META (-45): AI security headline; META (1W: +0.54% | 1M: -4.36%) RECOVERY — news adds risk to an otherwise short-term bounce.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-ON with a Growth/Momentum tilt and narrow leadership dominated by Technology; Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. MSFT (1W: +24.82% | 1M: +25.36%) ABOVE TREND and PLTR (1W: +28.80% | 1M: +17.91%) ABOVE TREND are showing the most strength while AAPL (1W: -8.04% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION highlights a notable divergence. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across large names (multiple RECOVERY/CORRECTION signals) and headline-driven sentiment (JPM, KHC, META) that could trigger short-term rotation.
